name: com.zapmatte/green-screen-remover
title: Zapmatte Green Screen Remover
description: Remove green or blue screens from videos. Get ProRes 4444, transparent WebM, alpha matte or MP4.

tools.name: list_removal_options
tools.description: List Zapmatte quality options, credits per second of video, accepted formats and limits, and the files each job returns. Public; no key needed.

tools.name: estimate_removal_cost
tools.description: Return the exact credit cost of removing the green screen from a video of a given length. Free; does not start a job or reserve credits.

durationSeconds.description: Length of the video in seconds (decimals allowed).

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Read your spendable Zapmatte credit balance (1 credit = 1 second at Standard). Requires a key.

tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: Screen a video and get a one-time upload URL. Send its duration, size, width, height and 1-4 JPEG frames (raw base64, no data URL, each up to 300 KB) sampled across the clip for content moderation. Then PUT the video bytes to putUrl with the returned contentType, and pass key as uploadKey to remove_green_screen. Requires a key.

fileName.description: Original file name, e.g. clip.mp4 (the extension sets the format).

tools.name: remove_green_screen
tools.description: Start a paid green screen removal with user approval and an exact expectedCredits quote. Needs uploadKey from create_upload (after the PUT). Required requestId deduplicates identical retries for 24h; never use a new id to retry an uncertain submission. Returns taskId.

durationSeconds.description: Length of the video in seconds (decimals allowed).

requestId.description: Unique submission id, e.g. a UUID. Reuse for identical retries within 24 hours; never change after an uncertain outcome.

uploadKey.description: key returned by create_upload, after the video file was PUT to its putUrl.

background.description: Transparent (ProRes, WebM, matte) or a solid colour (adds an MP4).

color.description: Hex colour such as #000000, when type is "color".

tools.name: get_removal_status
tools.description: Check your own job. Poll no faster than every 5 seconds. On success returns outputs (URLs of the ProRes MOV, WebM, matte, preview and, for colour backgrounds, MP4) and the result page; failed jobs are refunded automatically. Requires a key.
